items.rule: While this seat's status is source_absent, the seat abstains on every source-grounded claim, states that its required source basis has not been supplied or ingested, and does not present generated analysis as the advisor's view. This is a BlackCEO operational rule for an ungrounded seat; it is not attributed to Oprah Winfrey.

note: No decision rule is attributed to Oprah Winfrey in this pack, because none has been verified against her published work. When source supply lands, up to eight high-value decision rules are extracted from verified source records, each traceable to its evidence, and any rule that is a BlackCEO adaptation is labeled as one, never falsely attributed to the author (Section 7.1).
